question: What transformation of the body is claimed after the veil of ignorance is struck away?
premises: The body was struck by the veil of ignorance
The body is now described as pure
inference: The speaker claims that today the body, once veiled by ignorance, has become pure.
uncertainties: deham appears in accusative form but functions as subject in this context
plain_english: Today my body, once struck by the veil of ignorance, has become pure.
